title: Draft Lab

archetypes.name: RB Heavy
archetypes.description: At least 45% of weighted draft capital invested at RB.

archetypes.name: WR Heavy
archetypes.description: At least 42% of weighted draft capital invested at WR.

archetypes.name: QB Heavy
archetypes.description: At least 22% of weighted draft capital invested at QB.

archetypes.name: TE Premium
archetypes.description: First TE by pick 30 or at least 14% of capital invested at TE.

archetypes.name: Early QB
archetypes.description: First QB selected by overall pick 25.

archetypes.name: Double Early QB
archetypes.description: Second QB selected by overall pick 40.

archetypes.name: Zero RB
archetypes.description: No RB selected before overall pick 50.

archetypes.name: Hero RB
archetypes.description: First RB by pick 15, but less than 45% total RB capital.

archetypes.name: Hero WR
archetypes.description: First WR by pick 15, but less than 42% total WR capital.

archetypes.name: RB Avalanche
archetypes.description: At least three RBs selected in the first 50 overall picks.

archetypes.name: Balanced
archetypes.description: No core position exceeds its heavy threshold and no early-double-QB flag.

notes: 2017 is excluded because its Yahoo board was entered in roster-position order rather than true draft order.
Archetypes can overlap. Results describe this league's history and do not establish causation.
All capital percentages use the configurable values in data/draftCapital.json.
